name: retro-review
description: Retrospective review of decision-ledger entries: per-decision outcome marking and adoption-pattern summaries over past partner recommendations.
when_to_use: Use to review a slice of decisions.jsonl entries pasted into the request, mark each recorded decision outcome (validated, regretted or pending) with reasoning and summarize adoption patterns by partner and project.
